newsitem.title: USA: West Coast crude market thin, LATAM supply weighs.
newsitem.headline: West Coast crude market thin, LATAM supply weighs.

text.p: The U.S. West Coast crude market was thin early Thursday, though traders said a number of South American cargoes remained on offere and were pressuring differentials.
"There are at least five new varieties of crude on offer," said one refiner.
Among those on offer was a cargo of Venezulan Tia Jauna Heavy (12.3 API gravity, 2.82 sulphur), a Colombian South Blend (29, 0.8) and a number of Ecuadorean Oriente (28.8, 1.02).
